state.question: Has Cirrus Connect's operating change resolved the question about on-time operations? Focus on: September arrival punctuality within fifteen minutes and the change from August under the same definition.
state.conclusion: Cirrus introduced a revised hub schedule.
state.gap: September arrival punctuality within fifteen minutes and the change from August under the same definition.

candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Cirrus Connect's strategy in on-time operations, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.
